title: Intervention records with a point-key frequency cap
action: Plan Phase 2, first half (per c80debd7): interventions are FILE RECORDS with frequency-cap state. Extend the supervisor verb group: `bee supervisor record` gains --kind intervention, which REQUIRES --target-session, a --point-key (a stable slug naming the point being touched), and --question (an open question, at most 2 sentences — refuse longer). Frequency cap per c80debd7: the SECOND record for the same (target_session, point_key) is refused as a plain intervention and must be recorded with --kind escalation instead (same fields; the refusal names this remedy) — never repeat the same point. Add `bee supervisor pending --target-session <id> --json` listing undelivered intervention/escalation rows, and `bee supervisor mark-delivered --id <row-id>` stamping delivered_at (rows get a stable id). Keep observation|silence behavior byte-identical. Follow the existing validation-before-write seam; extend the same tests file: cap fires on second same-point record; escalation accepted; pending lists only undelivered; mark-delivered stamps and is idempotent-refusing on unknown id. Regen deferred to the wave barrier.

truths: a second intervention on the same (target_session, point_key) is refused naming --kind escalation as the remedy
pending lists only undelivered rows for the named session
